name: nat_vent_thermostat_cycling
description: Issue #321: Nat-vent fan cycles on/off based on indoor midpoint thresholds during an active session. Config: comfort_heat=68, comfort_cool=74 → midpoint=71, off_threshold=70, on_threshold=72. Fan turns off when indoor drops to 70°F; turns on again when indoor rises to 72°F with outdoor still below indoor; session ends on comfort_heat floor breach.
notes: (a) Scenario effectiveness: deleting nat_vent_temperature_check() from automation.py
causes the second assertion (expect nat_vent_fan_off at 10:30) to FAIL —
the fan would stay on indefinitely regardless of indoor temperature.
must document cycling thresholds (midpoint±1°F) before this is promoted to golden.
(c) Occupant experience: without cycling, the fan runs continuously during nat-vent,
potentially over-cooling the home 2-3°F below the comfort floor. With cycling,
the home is held near the band midpoint (71°F), improving sleep comfort.

events.note: Morning: indoor=73°F (above midpoint=71°F), outdoor=65°F. outdoor < indoor — nat-vent conditions met.
Mild day classification: hvac_mode=off. Nat-vent eligible when sensors open.
User opens window. outdoor=65°F < indoor=73°F, indoor > comfort_heat=68°F, outdoor < threshold 77°F. Nat-vent activates, fan turns on.
Indoor cooled to off_threshold=70°F (midpoint=71-1=70). Fan should cycle off. Nat-vent session stays active.
Indoor warmed back to on_threshold=72°F (midpoint=71+1=72). outdoor=65°F < indoor=72°F — fan cycles back on.

Indoor reaches comfort_heat floor=68°F. The COMFORT_FLOOR exit candidate arms via decide_nat_vent_exit() but is NOT yet sustain-confirmed (Issue #821, NAT_VENT_EXIT_SUSTAIN_S=90s) — session still active this tick.
95s after indoor first reached the floor (> 90s NAT_VENT_EXIT_SUSTAIN_S) — indoor still at the floor. Hard exit condition sustain-confirms and commits: nat-vent session ends, fan deactivated.

assertions.reason: Sensor opened with outdoor=65°F < indoor=73°F, outdoor < comfort_cool+delta=77°F — nat-vent activates and fan turns on.
nat_vent_temperature_check called with indoor=70°F = off_threshold (midpoint=71-1=70). Fan cycles off to avoid overcooling. Session remains active.
nat_vent_temperature_check called with indoor=72°F = on_threshold (midpoint=71+1=72), outdoor=65°F < indoor. Fan cycles back on to resume free cooling.
Indoor=68°F reaches comfort_heat floor=68°F, sustained for 95s (Issue #821, NAT_VENT_EXIT_SUSTAIN_S=90s) — hard nat-vent exit: session ends, fan deactivated, HVAC may resume.

verdict.summary: Nat-vent fan cycles on/off at midpoint±1°F thresholds; session ends on floor breach
verdict.observed_behavior: natural_ventilation on window open → nat_vent_fan_off at 70°F → nat_vent_fan_on at 72°F → nat_vent_comfort_floor_exit at 68°F
verdict.expected_behavior: Fan cycles to hold indoor near comfort band midpoint (71°F); occupant stays comfortable without overcooling; session ends cleanly when floor is reached
